create_prepend_token_dataset: create a PrependTokenDataset that prepends a specified token to each item in a wrapped dataset
build_dataset_with_token: build a dataset wrapper that automatically prepends a token ID to every sequence item
test_getitem_prepend: test the PrependTokenDataset getitem method to verify tokens are correctly prepended to items
review_sizes_property: review the PrependTokenDataset sizes property to confirm it accounts for the prepended token
refactor_num_tokens: refactor the PrependTokenDataset num_tokens method to handle edge cases with None tokens
